propositions: The portability criterion's Platform and venue matrix cell conflates diverse CI providers and non-CI environments under a single undifferentiated 'CI' label, leaving the no-CI-provider shape unnameable and undetectable by the plan-review gate.

Story A and story B replaced operation-linked compaction triggers with GitHub-Actions-only scheduling, silently breaking adopters with no CI provider because the criterion cannot name or detect that alternate venue.

The criterion detection text must split the matrix cell to name both 'CI under any provider (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and others)' and 'projects with NO CI provider at all', and add a rule stating that a capability whose only trigger is a specific CI system requires an operation-linked or in-process fallback or is a finding.

The authoritative wording must be pinned in the rubric prompt, mirrored in docs/plan-review-gate.md with matching tests, surfaced in AGENTS.md as a one-line pointer, and verified live with an A/B plan-review run showing zero findings pre-change and one finding post-change against identical scratch plan text.
